tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The plane the app shell floats on. Visible as a margin around the shell above 1200px and nowhere else.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The app shell, every panel and every table. The default ground for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the mobile filter sheet. In dark it lifts a step above surface; in light the shadow does the lifting.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground, table header strip, row hover, quiet button hover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline between table rows and list items, inside a panel only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Panel edge, input border, sidebar divider, the rule under a table header. Anything that has to be seen.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, table cells, agency names. 16.3:1 on surface light, 12.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Column headers, domains, relative dates, hints. 5.0:1 on surface and 4.7:1 on surface-muted light, 6.7:1 dark. The quietest text the system allows.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The primary button fill, the active sidebar item and the Won badge. One per screen.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and active state of anything filled with brand.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind brand-ink: the Opportunity badge, the sidebar hover, a success notice.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and marks on brand-soft. 5.8:1 light, 8.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: The label on a brand fill. White in light, near-black in dark because brand lightens there. 6.5:1 and 6.9:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus-visible ring on every interactive element, at 2px offset. Solid, never dashed.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue counts and dates, the Hot badge, destructive text. 5.7:1 on danger-soft light, 6.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: The Overdue stat card, the Hot badge and error notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due-today dates, the Potential (Warm) and Warm badges. 5.3:1 on warning-soft light, 7.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: The Due today stat card and caution notices.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: The Email Sequence and Cold badges. 6.7:1 on info-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind info.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral badge fill, the count chip on a tab, the track behind a bar.

tokens.name: avatar-bg
tokens.usage: The circle behind an agency initial. One colour for every agency; a per-agency hue would imply a category that does not exist.

tokens.name: avatar-ink
tokens.usage: The initial inside avatar-bg. 15.1:1 light, 8.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: stage-won
tokens.usage: Won in the pipeline bar. Step 1 of a five-step ordinal ramp, validated for monotone lightness and a 2:1 light-end floor in both themes.

tokens.name: stage-opportunity
tokens.usage: Opportunity in the pipeline bar. Ramp step 2.

tokens.name: stage-potential
tokens.usage: Potential (Warm) in the pipeline bar. Ramp step 3.

tokens.name: stage-sequence
tokens.usage: Email Sequence in the pipeline bar. Ramp step 4.

tokens.name: stage-out
tokens.usage: Not Interested in the pipeline bar. Ramp step 5, nearest the surface at 2.1:1 light and 2.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Every bar in a single-measure chart, such as agencies by country. One hue, because the bars are one series and length already carries the comparison.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and the track behind a bar. Recessive; never darker than border.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: The baseline of a chart.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, top left of the content area.

styles.name: page-sub
styles.usage: The sentence under a page title that says what the screen holds today.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: An agency name in a table row or list item.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy: notes, summaries, next steps.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Domains, relative dates, hints. Always in ink-muted.

styles.name: column
styles.usage: Table column headers, in ink-muted. Sentence case, not uppercase.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Stage and temperature badges, tab counts.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, menu items, select values.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The figure on a stat card. Always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: metric-sm
styles.usage: A secondary figure, such as a deal total in a panel header.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Counts in a legend, a table numeric cell or a tab chip. Tabular nums.

spacing.note: A 4px step. Touch targets on mobile are 44px regardless of which step gets them there.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to value, icon to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between inline controls and between badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, list row vertical padding, gap between stat cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between panels, the content gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop where a panel holds a chart.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The content gutter on desktop, and the gap under a page header.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Padding inside an empty state.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space below the last panel. On mobile this clears the bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, menu items, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Stat cards, panels, menus, the mobile row card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The app shell on desktop and the mobile filter sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, avatars, the pipeline bar, chips.

shadow.note: Three levels. Depth separates planes; it never decorates.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Panels and stat cards.

tokens.name: shadow-shell
tokens.usage: The app shell against canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the mobile sheet.
